notes: 1.0.40: Adds a dedicated App update section (Firmware tab) - a Check for update button, a status pill that shows whether you are up to date or a new version is available, and an Update now button. The app also pops a one-time notification when it starts if an update is waiting. The amber Update button at the top still works too. Carries the more-robust updater and the signed program file from 1.0.39.
